propositions: code-review.yaml declares per-step model classes on five LLM steps that are silently ignored at runtime; every call executes on cfg.model regardless of declaration
PydanticAIRunner.run discards req.config and resolves models from self._config only, making per-step model configurations invisible to the runner
usage_log lacks step attribution; log records only prompt name (op) which cannot distinguish between base step and batch finder both using code-review-base prompt
the fix routes per-step model from RunRequest through to resolver by substituting req.config.model into cfg when they differ, making all declared per-step models take effect
step identifier and raw declared model token must be threaded via ContextVar to make usage log attribution and per-pass verification possible
